import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health & Lifestyle Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Plot 1: Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by BMI Category
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='Sleep Duration', y='Quality of Sleep', 
                hue='BMI Category', style='Gender', s=80, alpha=0.7, ax=ax1)
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality by BMI Category', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='BMI / Gender', bbox_to_anchor=(1.02, 1), loc='upper left', fontsize=9)

# Plot 2: Distribution of Sleep Duration by Sleep Disorder
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
# Fill NaN with 'None' for better visualization
df_disorder = df.copy()
df_disorder['Sleep Disorder'] = df_disorder['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')
sns.boxplot(data=df_disorder, x='Sleep Disorder', y='Sleep Duration', 
            palette='Set2', ax=ax2)
ax2.set_xlabel('Sleep Disorder', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Sleep Duration Distribution by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# Plot 3: Correlation between Stress Level and Physical Activity
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='Physical Activity Level', y='Stress Level',
                hue='Quality of Sleep', palette='RdYlGn', size='Daily Steps',
                sizes=(20, 200), alpha=0.7, ax=ax3)
ax3.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level (minutes/day)', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Stress Level (1-10)', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Physical Activity vs Stress Level\n(colored by Sleep Quality, sized by Daily Steps)', 
              fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.legend(title='Sleep Quality', bbox_to_anchor=(1.02, 1), loc='upper left', fontsize=9)

# Plot 4: Average Sleep Quality by Occupation
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
occupation_sleep = df.groupby('Occupation')['Quality of Sleep'].mean().sort_values(ascending=True)
colors = plt.cm.viridis(occupation_sleep.values / occupation_sleep.max())
bars = ax4.barh(occupation_sleep.index, occupation_sleep.values, color=colors)
ax4.set_xlabel('Average Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Occupation', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Average Sleep Quality by Occupation', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.axvline(x=df['Quality of Sleep'].mean(), color='red', linestyle='--', 
            label=f'Overall Mean: {df["Quality of Sleep"].mean():.2f}')
ax4.legend(loc='lower right', fontsize=9)

# Add value labels on bars
for bar, val in zip(bars, occupation_sleep.values):
    ax4.text(val + 0.05, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, 
             f'{val:.1f}', va='center', fontsize=9)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
